minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the Verizon cell tower and the Unitil-area car wash hearings to later dates; no permits were granted.
minutes.summary: The board approved a minor drainage change for Unit L at 357 Electric Avenue, then heard a Verizon 75-foot monopole application at the high school track. The tower needs a supermajority, so it was continued to July 10. A two-bay car wash site plan at Electric Avenue was continued to June 26, and the board discussed how to interview applicants for its vacancy.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment on non-agenda items; none stated.
Asked for a recap of the tower history, why the tower was moved 20 feet, and the lease amount.
Asked about the generator: type, fuel, emissions and noise.
Spoke in favor of the car wash project as economic development and urged the board to act quickly.

votes.motion: Accept the changes to the Unit L plan (catch basin and pipe) as a de minimis change.
Continue the Verizon Wireless special permit and site plan hearing to July 10 at 6:30.
Continue the car wash site plan hearing to June 26.
Approval of the May 22, 2017 minutes (comments asked; no motion heard).

budget_items.topic: Verizon tower lease to the town
budget_items.what_was_said: A resident asked the lease amount; the applicant recalled a figure from town meeting and said they would confirm it. Lease revenue is intended to help fund the track upgrade.
A member raised the cost of the new high school and wanted the pavement protected from the utility trench. The applicant noted a town bond requirement could cover settling.
A change to the erosion control notes was said to possibly cost extra from the contractor.

decisions.decision: The board said the Verizon special permit needs a supermajority, so no decision could be made that night.
Board to submit questions on lighting and maintenance via the applicant to the facilities manager and the Board of Selectmen, as the lease owner.
The review engineer will return a review of the revised car wash plans before the June 26 meeting.
Applicants for the board vacancy to be interviewed June 26 or July 10, with questions submitted to the director by each member in advance. The joint meeting with Selectmen is on the 18th.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the Verizon Wireless 75-foot monopole hearing to July 10; no decision was made because a special permit needs a supermajority.
The board continued the Electric Avenue car wash site plan hearing to June 26; the vote was not audible in the recording.
The board accepted a catch basin and pipe change to the Unit L plan at 357 Electric Avenue as a de minimis change.
The review engineer is to return a review of the revised car wash plans before the June 26 meeting.
The board discussed interviewing applicants for its vacancy on June 26 or July 10, with questions sent to the director in advance.

why_it_matters: The tower lease is meant to help fund the high school track upgrade, and the lease amount was not confirmed at the meeting, so the revenue to the town remains unstated.
The tower and car wash are still undecided, so neither can proceed until the board votes at a later hearing, and residents can still comment at those hearings.
